# EctoContext v0.4.1 - Table of Contents

Scoped CRUD with permission layer via macro DSL for Ecto schemas.

## Pages

- [Changelog](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/changelog.md)

## Modules

- [EctoContext](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.md): Generates standard data access functions for Ecto-backed contexts at compile time.
- [EctoContext.Check.Design.NoEctoQueryOutsideAppLib](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Check.Design.NoEctoQueryOutsideAppLib.md): ## Basics
- [EctoContext.Check.Design.NoRepoOutsideAppLib](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Check.Design.NoRepoOutsideAppLib.md): ## Basics
- [EctoContext.Check.Design.NoUnscopedRepoInsideAppLib](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Check.Design.NoUnscopedRepoInsideAppLib.md): ## Basics
- [EctoContext.Check.Helpers](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Check.Helpers.md): Shared helpers for EctoContext Credo checks.
- [EctoContext.Check.Warning.DeprecateRepoTransaction](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Check.Warning.DeprecateRepoTransaction.md): ## Basics
- [EctoContext.Paginator](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Paginator.md): Pagination result struct containing entries, total count, and page metadata.
- [EctoContext.Query](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Query.md): Query helpers used by the EEx templates in `priv/templates/ecto_context/`.
- [EctoContext.Validate](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/EctoContext.Validate.md): Validation helpers used by the EEx templates in `priv/templates/ecto_context/`.

## Mix Tasks

- [mix ecto_context.install](https://ecto-context.hexdocs.pm/Mix.Tasks.EctoContext.Install.md): Applies ecto_context setup to the project
